# SPACIA by Srijan Realty

SPACIA is a residential and retail development at Jessore Road South, Mouza Doharia, Ward 09, beside Reliance Mall, Madhyamgram, Kolkata 700129. It has 449 apartments across six G+12 towers on 3.6 acres, with 64% open space and 3 BHK and 4 BHK homes. The project is IGBC Platinum Pre-Certified and registered as WBRERA/P/NOR/2025/003059. Possession is planned for 2030; confirm the RERA completion date with Srijan Realty.

- Project website: https://spacia-one.vercel.app/
- Official Srijan Realty project page: https://www.srijanrealty.com/property/spacia/
- West Bengal RERA: https://rera.wb.gov.in/
- Project enquiries: +91 84449 11007
